label: available
notes: a pause is a run of frames with p < end_threshold after the segment opened, ended by a frame with p >= end_threshold, in whole 32 ms frames
percentiles use numpy linear interpolation, and clip_max_pause_ms counts a clip without a pause as 0
shares are over the clips in which the vad opened a segment
a clip is split when it opens two or more segments, and split by a pause when a segment opens after a silence endpoint rather than the forced one
added latency is the tail: the setting rounded up to whole frames, before the endpoint frame arrives
wait = added latency + service-side latency of the bench's <= 5 s bucket (endpoint frame arrival to final emission), from the end of speech to the final state
groups repeat the summary for the clips of each --wavs pattern
